title: The census of fair contacts on square tori
claim: With the same placed three-variable contact C(h_u, x_e, h_v) on every edge of a square-lattice torus (east and north), hidden joints and fair visible spokes: (1) the 204 placements of the 34 three-variable knots form 10 classes with equal consistency laws under spoke swap, joint-value swap and reversal; (2) six classes have a vacuum and hold nothing; parity holds the cycle rank and swap-or-order is frustrated by a 2 x 3 domino (8 of 128 patterns), so both grow with the area; not-all-equal and 'x or (h != h')' are consistent on every bipartite graph and hold only global emergence; (3) 'x or (h != h')' is consistent exactly when its h != h' edges, Bernoulli(1/2) percolation, are bipartite, that is when no cluster has a cross topology or winds in a class of odd length; its emergence is bounded away from 0 and from infinity at fixed shape (crossing bounds and positive correlation); Pinson's conformal formula predicts its limit, 1.508460 bits on square tori with both sides odd and 1.985201 bits on 1:2 tori with one odd side.
failure_conditions: A placement whose class differs from the stated ten, or two placements of one class with different consistency counts on the 3 x 2 torus.
A vacuum class with an inconsistent pattern; a smallest frustrating patch other than one face (parity) or the domino (swap-or-order); a frustrating patch for not-all-equal or 'x or (h != h')'.
A pattern where consistency of 'x or (h != h')' differs from bipartiteness of its h != h' edges, or bipartiteness differs from the absence of an odd topology.
The Pinson implementation failing to reproduce Newman and Ziff's reference values or to sum to 1.
foundation_claim_scope: Emergence of networks of one placed three-variable contact with hidden joints and fair visible spokes on square-lattice tori, classified over all placements. Lattices are declared; no space or physics is claimed.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py enumerates all 204 placements into 10 classes with equal laws on the 3 x 2 torus, the vacuum classes, the smallest frustrating grid patches up to 3 x 4, parity's count on the 3 x 3 torus, the bipartite reduction against an independent winding classification on all 262,144 patterns of the 3 x 3 torus and 60,000 sampled patterns of larger tori, and the Pinson implementation against Newman and Ziff's values; four controls rejected; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with exhaustive checks; the two-sided bounds (Theorem 6) are argued from cited crossing bounds and positive correlation; Pinson's limit is a cited conformal prediction, not a theorem; no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: candidate-local-delta: the census of placed contacts and its three regimes are elementary consequences of earlier proofs; the reduction of 'x or (h != h')' worlds to bipartiteness of critical percolation on the torus is elementary (frustration of diluted antiferromagnets), with moderate folklore risk; identifying a three-literal world's emergence with Pinson's torus winding probabilities was not found in a bounded search.
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-22.
